name: Reviews
description: Product reviews with a rating: the shop's own criteria (which apply everywhere or to chosen categories), pros and cons, a recommendation, and a verified-purchase mark. Guests never write one — an account is the cheapest honest barrier — and everything is checked before it is published. The average and its 1-5 spread are recomputed as reviews are published, so a card, a listing and the page's structured data all read one number.

settings.label: Check reviews before publishing
settings.help: On by default, and worth leaving on. A review is printed next to a price and stays there for years; a shop that finds an advert or a competitor's link under its best-selling product switches reviews off for good, which is the same outcome as never having them.

settings.label: Only customers who bought the product may review it
settings.help: Off by default: a strict shop gets fewer reviews than it has customers, because people buy by phone, as a gift, or from a shop nearby. Whoever did buy is marked as a verified purchase either way — the mark is what a reader believes, and it costs no one their voice.

settings.label: Ask for pros and cons separately
Line above the form (a reward for reviewing, a house rule)
settings.help: Printed above the review form when it is filled in, and nothing is drawn when it is empty. Plain words on purpose: this engine awards nothing by itself, so a shop that pays for reviews says here exactly what it pays and stays the one who decides who earned it.

settings.label: Tell this address about new reviews
settings.help: Empty means the storefront's own contact address. A review waiting for moderation that nobody knows about is why this is sent by the module rather than left to an automation rule.

settings.label: Photos a review may carry
settings.help: 0 turns photographs off. They are published with the review, so a review waiting for moderation shows nobody its pictures. Images only, checked by their contents and resized by the media module.

settings.label: Variations share their reviews
settings.help: Products with the same variation group are one model to a reader: every member's page, card stars and "best rated" place count the reviews of all of them, and a review written about another variation says which one. Each review still belongs to the variation it was written on, so switching this off splits them back with nothing lost.

settings.label: The list on the product page
Reviews shown at first
settings.help: And as many more each time "Show more" is pressed.

settings.label: Filters from this many reviews
settings.help: A period, the stars, buyers only and with photos — drawn once a product has at least this many reviews; 0 never. A filter in force is always shown, so a reader can take it off.

settings.label: A strip of the customers' photos over the list
settings.help: Every published review's photographs in one row, from two of them on.

settings.label: The most helpful positive and critical review side by side, from this many reviews
settings.help: Only when both exist and each has at least one "helpful" vote — the most helpful of three is a coin toss. 0 never.
